name: s07-release-script-tests
command:
import subprocess
for command in [["bash","-n","deploy/resolve-release-tag.sh","deploy/tests/release-tag-preflight-test.sh","deploy/tests/release-publish-config-test.sh","backend/scripts/resolve-version.sh"],["bash","deploy/tests/release-tag-preflight-test.sh"],["bash","deploy/tests/release-publish-config-test.sh"]]:
 print("$",*command,flush=True)
 result=subprocess.run(["rtk","proxy",*command])
 print("exit_code="+str(result.returncode),flush=True)
 assert result.returncode==0
